runtime_required: Fit true turned bounds against clear_box exactly, without the old 1.25 multiplier or 2cm allowance.
Use bottom_position_unity, not legacy position as a bottom.
Classify backpack names before generic Shoulder and enforce item_name_filter; keep generic armor out.
Respect accepted_item_types in overflow; no cross-type fallback into empty backpack, saddle or flat tray cells.
Reserve Feaster for its flat quaternion; never rotate a Tool upright solely to fill a place.
Keep root scale 1; do not substitute type median dimensions for unknown mod tools.

coordinate_validation.method: Independent raw OBJ vertex transform readback against serialized final mirror meshes

clear_box_contract.space: Unity prefab axes x,up,front; same as box_size
clear_box_contract.format: [width,height,depth] metres, bottom centred at clear_box_bottom_unity = bottom_position_unity
clear_box_contract.scope: largest box within the reserved, non-overlapping allocation cell; no finite global maximum exists in an open bay
clear_box_contract.fit: true rotated item bounds <= clear_box, no multiplier and no padding
